concepts.name: Lenz's Law
concepts.simple_definition: Lenz's Law states that the direction of an induced current always opposes the change in magnetic flux that produced it.
concepts.deep_explanation: This law is a consequence of the law of conservation of energy, represented by the negative sign in Faraday's Law: ε = -N(dΦ/dt).
concepts.real_example: Pushing a magnet into a coil of wire induces a current that creates a magnetic field repelling the incoming magnet.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking Lenz's law allows creating free energy. It prevents free energy creation by requiring work to push the magnet.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: የሌንዝ ሕግ እንደሚገልጸው የተፈጠረው የኤሌክትሪክ ፍሰት አቅጣጫ ሁልጊዜ እንዲፈጠር ካደረገው የማግኔቲክ ለውጥ ጋር ይቃረናል።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: ይህ ሕግ የኢነርጂ ጥበቃ ሕግ መገለጫ ሲሆን በፋራዳይ ሕግ ውስጥ በአሉታዊ ምልክት (-) ይገለጻል፦ ε = -N(dΦ/dt)።
concepts.real_example_amharic: ማግኔትን ወደ ሽቦ ጠምዛዛ ሲገፉት፣ ማግኔቱን የሚገፋ ተቃራኒ የኤሌክትሪክ ፍሰት ይፈጠራል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: የሌንዝ ሕግ ያለምንም ሥራ ኃይል መፍጠር ያስችላል ብሎ ማሰብ።
